rows.title: Full-member compression distribution
rows.finding: 3.9 GPa is typical catalog compression, not a fitted scale at a known reference size. The 1 GPa baseline is only a ranking target.
rows.proposed_fix: Measure the actual full-length/full-wall production tube population in compression, including finish, joints and proof history.

rows.title: Linear frame and local shell interaction
rows.finding: Constant-g/R scaling retains checked linear fields. The 0.2 eigen knockdown and local peak substitution do not qualify imperfections or nonlinear collapse.
rows.proposed_fix: Validate joints, geometric imperfections and coupled local/global behavior for the final resized sections.

rows.title: Rigid joints
rows.finding: Sleeve sizing does not demonstrate rotational stiffness, peel, torsion, fatigue or temperature-dependent bond behavior.
rows.proposed_fix: Demonstrate the assembled joint stiffness and multiaxial load envelope at the actual installation.

rows.title: PBO effective ply strength
rows.finding: The 10 m least root requires about 5.343 GPa effective ply strength; 60% of yarn strength does not close this radius even with the other endpoints.
rows.proposed_fix: Measure biaxial crossply strength, construction efficiency, seams, attachments and sustained load.

rows.title: Ten-year retention
rows.finding: Warehouse extrapolation and .995/year protection target are not measured installed life. OD4 and white mass do not establish a durable coating.
rows.proposed_fix: Qualify combined light, humidity, stress, temperature, abrasion, fatigue and repair histories.

rows.title: Humidity criterion and service
rows.finding: 5% of cold saturation is a design target; h=2 shortens the nominal first interval. Initial fill is assumed dry.
rows.proposed_fix: Measure the complete internal dewpoint distribution and establish an operating interval including uncertainty.

rows.title: Barrier leakage and conditioning
rows.finding: OD3 coupon gas/WVTR and old outgassing inventories are transferred to installed OD4; 90% removal is assumed demonstrated.
rows.proposed_fix: Measure whole-hull leak acceptance, installed WVTR and a compatible conditioning endpoint.

rows.title: Onboard pumping and energy
rows.finding: 15–148 pump units arise from constant nominal-speed and 1000 W planning assumptions; this is not optimized or qualified hardware.
rows.proposed_fix: Obtain installed wet-speed curves near 32.5 Pa and a complete power/heat/plumbing design; recalculate changed barrier and power architectures explicitly.

rows.title: Load introduction and wind
rows.finding: Uniform pressure envelope and a P2-sized pad mass do not establish P3 attachment strength or nonuniform wind loading.
rows.proposed_fix: Resolve full wind, gust, mooring, payload, cable and landing load paths on the discrete frame.

rows.title: Damage tolerance
rows.finding: 045 reports cascading member loss and running tears in predecessor configurations. No damage-tolerance repair is qualified or silently assigned zero cost here.
rows.proposed_fix: Demonstrate residual strength, tear arrest, impact resistance and realistic protection/inspection; carry all added mass.

rows.title: Size scaling and optimality
rows.finding: Only the two checked f5 gyration families are assessed. Larger manufactured tubes and thermal interactions are not validated.
rows.proposed_fix: Search further sections/topologies using independently checked force/eigen solutions and manufacturing limits before claiming a global radius minimum.

rows.title: Installed inventory
rows.finding: Systems100, node, installation and mooring lines are planning allowances. The 10 m full-endpoint margin is only about 31 kg.
rows.proposed_fix: Replace allowances with a component bill including sensors, fixtures, mounting, valves, access, repair and handling hardware.

rows.title: Gas and water location
rows.finding: Bores must be vented. Material water is counted once in material mass; exterior .1 kg/m² water is separate. More external water can erase the margin.
rows.proposed_fix: Verify bore venting, actual liquid retention/drainage and material moisture at launch.

rows.title: P2 comparability
rows.finding: P2 endpoints have different unqualified material, thermal, bond and life assumptions. 048 stopped at radius15.
rows.proposed_fix: Do not rank confidence from payload or axis count; any larger-radius 048 extension needs its own thermal and mechanical calculation.

rows.title: Reliability aggregation
rows.finding: Only an intact-member compression hazard envelope is reported. Independence, compression m=10, load sharing and reference volume are hypothetical.
rows.proposed_fix: Calibrate failure mechanisms and common causes before assembling a hull probability; do not substitute either number for installed reliability.
